entry.title: New: dsh-music-player
entry.summary: Play your own local music in the DSH web UI: the host scans a local folder (default ~/Music) and streams it over HTTP, with a now-playing bar (prev/play/stop, loop modes, volume, live spectrum) and a draggable playlist panel, plus a model-invokable `music_play` tool. Exact install spec: dsh-music-player. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
